system.description: Your cyberware is fully integrated into your nervous system. When you finish a rest, choose Agility, Strength, or Finesse as your Calibrated Trait. When you make an action roll using your Calibrated Trait or use a Chrome card, you can mark a Stress to roll a d6 and add its result to the roll. Additionally, when you roll your Humanity Die to resist Cyberpsychosis, treat your Cyber Load as 1 lower, to a minimum of 0.
